subject: Missing self-serve trial credits after PLG signup — manual reconciliation?
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:14:22 -0800
Subject: Trial credits showing 0 after signup

Hi Karthik,

We signed up our team this morning (via the PLG flow) to evaluate Redwood and expected the stated $500 trial credit to appear on our billing dashboard. The billing page shows a balance of $0 and attempts to apply coupon REDWOOD-BOOST-2026 at signup returned "applied" but no credit units. I attached a screenshot of the dashboard and the raw signup headers.

Can you confirm whether the credits were issued? We need to run a quick PoC tomorrow and the credits determine whether we can proceed.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Platform Engineer
Acme Analytics

Attachment: screenshot-credits-zero.png (image/png)
Attachment: signup-headers.txt (text/plain)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:33:59 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial credits showing 0 after signup

Hi Samir — thanks for the report and for including the screenshots. Sorry for the friction here.

Quick checks I've done: the signup event registered in our PLG analytics and the coupon code REDWOOD-BOOST-2026 was marked as "applied" in the front-end flow. However, it looks like the backend job that converts applied coupons into ledger credits failed for a subset of signups between 09:00-09:40 PST this morning due to a transient validation error.

I'm escalating to operations to reconcile and, in the meantime, I can apply a manual credit to your account so you can run your PoC.

Action items:
- Monica (ops): can you confirm if the reconciliation run can be reprocessed for acme-analytics (external id: acct_54321) and, if not, apply a manual $500 credit?
- Samir: if you can confirm the account email used for the org (or share the HubSpot contact link), that'll speed things up.

I'll stay on this until it's resolved.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial credits showing 0 after signup

Karthik / Laura — looking into OPS-1147. I pulled the logs for acct_54321 and confirm the coupon-apply webhook was received but our crediting worker threw a 422 on validation: missing org.billing_profile_id. That explains why the coupon was displayed as applied on the client but no ledger entry was created.

Next steps we can do today:
- Re-run the reconciliation job for that signup batch (template: ops/reconcile-coupons) — low risk, will create ledger entries for valid rows.
- If reconciliation fails for that row again, I can create a manual ledger credit of $500 and flag the account so they don't get duplicated credits.

I'll try the re-run now and report back.

--Monica
Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: reconcile-job-output.log (uploaded to Jira)
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:12:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial credits showing 0 after signup

On re-run: job processed 1,243 rows in the 09:00 window. For acme-analytics (acct_54321) the reconciliation job failed again citing missing billing_profile_id in the POST payload captured at signup. I've created a manual ledger entry: +$500 trial credit, ledger id L-20261106-ACME-54321. Marked the account with tag: manual-credit-applied-20261106 to prevent duplicate reconciliation.

I also added a short remediation to OPS-1147 to backfill billing_profile_id for affected signups where possible.

Monica
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:19:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial credits showing 0 after signup

Samir — Monica applied the $500 trial credit manually. Can you please sign out and sign back into the console (or refresh the billing page) and confirm you now see a $500 balance? If you prefer, I can also extend your trial window by 7 days to make up for the delay.

Apologies again for the disruption — we want to make sure you can kick the tires.

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: support@acme-analytics.com
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 15:02:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial credits showing 0 after signup

Karthik / Monica / Laura — confirmed. The billing page now shows a $500 trial credit and the PoC runs. Thanks for the fast turnaround and the manual fix. We did need to refresh and re-open the console — that reflected the ledger change.

One ask: can you confirm this won't cause an accidental double-apply if we later correct the missing billing_profile_id in their signup record? Appreciate the tag you mentioned.

Samir
